fusions.name: Fangs of the Hill
fusions.desc: Breaks 3 stone fangs out of the ground in a spread out to 5 tiles; each deals 6 damage and has a 50% chance to leave its target [Sundered] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Digs the target out and bites, which deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Dug In
fusions.desc: Digs you into a scrape that absorbs the next 22 damage, up to 5 blows, for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Kicked-Up Scree
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
